ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Our ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Our Home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain People found at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Glucose and oxygen

2. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.

3. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.

5. D — Ice melting to water

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.

7. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

9. A — newton (N)

10. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

11. C — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

12. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
